info.description:
Complete API collection for ourSharedEvents Worker.
Separated from frontend pages. Covers: Health, Public Events, Admin Events, Forms (4 types), Feature Flags (8 endpoints).

item.name: OSE-R-003 SharedReport signed-link API (audit 2026-05-15)
item.description:
Locks the server contract the OSE-R-003 SharedReport HTML page depends on. The signed-link UI (workers/oursharedevents/src/handlers/pages.ts) keys friendly copy off body.code from these responses. If the contract breaks, bar owners see raw dev strings — the audit catches it here.

The matching vitest API spec lives at workers/oursharedevents/tests/sharedReport-signed-link-ui.spec.ts; the FE Playwright spec lives at tests/playwright/sharedReport-signed-link-ui.spec.ts.

item.name: OSE-R-003 | API | GET /api/v2/events/:id/shared-report (no Authorization header) | 401 with body.code=UNAUTHORIZED

exec: // OSE-R-003 (2026-05-15): the /sharedReport page's signed-link mode reads
// body.code to choose friendly copy. This locks the wire contract for the
// no-auth path: 401 + code=UNAUTHORIZED. If the server stops emitting `code`
// the UI falls through to the HTTP-status map — degraded but not broken —
// and this test flags the regression.
pm.test('WWW-Authenticate header advertises bearer realm', function() {
